paper_title: Search for an axion-like particle in radiative $J/ψ$ decays
notes: BESIII search for ALP in J/psi radiative decays, a->gamma gamma, mass range 0.165-2.84 GeV/c^2. Limit on g_agamma. Only explicit numerical coupling value in text: g_agamma > 3e-4 GeV^-1 excluded for m_a ~0.25 GeV (=2.5e8 eV). Full exclusion curve is in Fig.6 but not tabulated; data points cannot be reliably extracted from plot. Branching fraction limits given (8.3e-8 to 1.8e-6) but those are not coupling values.
